email.body1:
Eric, saw Merge adding service partners and scaling the unified API across more integration categories.

As the footprint grows, the real revops bottleneck is rarely the data, it is the latency between a signal firing and a touch going out, so in-market accounts cool before a rep reaches them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Merge off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Eric, quick follow-up for Merge.

Most revops teams can surface intent faster than the team can act on it, so signal-to-touch latency quietly caps conversion no matter how clean the data is. The measurable win is compressing that lag without adding reps to absorb the volume.

I put together a teardown of a signals-to-outbound motion, three things I would change to lift response rates 50 to 70 percent. Want to grab 15 minutes and I will walk you through it?
email.body3:
Eric, last bit of proof for Merge.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Merge's reply rate likely compares to other developer-tools startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
